headline: 20% of Japanese Firms Plan to Reduce Graduate Clerical Hiring as AI Adoption Expands
summary: Nearly one in five companies in Japan recruiting university graduates for clerical and administrative roles plans to reduce hiring volumes, attributing the cuts to the rapid integration of artificial intelligence tools.
why: Japan's corporate hiring practices offer early insight into how workplace automation affects white-collar employment.
